title: Pharmacotherapeutic role of astringin against chromium induced nephrotoxicity via modulating TLR4/MyD88, HMGB1/RAGE and NF-kappaB pathway: A biochemical and pharmacokinetic approach.
authors: Hu, Han; Hayat, Muhammad Faisal; Zahara, Syeda Sania; Akbar, Ali; Alzahrani, Khalid J; Alsharif, Khalaf F; Alzahrani, Fuad M; Al-Emam, Ahmed
journal: Journal of trace elements in medicine and biology : organ of the Society for Minerals and Trace Elements (GMS)
one_liner_zh: 该文研究astringin对铬致肾毒性的保护作用，聚焦氧化应激、炎症和凋亡通路，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chromium (Cr) is a noxious heavy metal that is reported to induce various organ damages including the kidneys. Astringin (ATN) is a polyphenolic flavonoid that demonstrates immense pharmacological potential. AIM: This research was planned to assess the potential palliative efficacy of ATN against Cr induced renal toxicity via regulating biochemical and histological parameters. METHODOLOGY: Thirty-two male albino (Sprague Dawley) rats were divided into four groups: the 1st group (control), 2nd group (Cr 15 mg/kg), 3rd group (Cr 15 mg/kg + ATN 10 mg/kg), and 4th (ATN 10 mg/kg) group. Gene profile was evaluated by using qRT-PCR protocol. The levels of other biochemical parameters were assessed through standard ELISA protocol as well as already reported standard assays. Histology was performed as per the basic principle of histopathology technique. The palliative role of ATN was further confirmed by molecular docking (MD) and molecular dynamic simulation (MDS) approach. RESULTS: Cr intoxication upregulated the gene expression of high mobility group box1 (HMGB1), tumor necrosis factor- alpha (TNF-alpha), nuclear factor- kappa B (NF-kappaB), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), interleukin-6 (IL-6), myeloid differentiation primary response 88 (MYD88), receptor for advanced glycation end products (RAGE), toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta). The levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde were elevated while the activities of glutathione reductase (GSR), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), superoxide dismutase (SOD) & catalase (CAT) as well as contents of glutathione (GSH) were reduced after Cr intoxication. Moreover, Cr exposure increased the levels of cystatin C, uric acid, neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin (NGAL), creatinine, blood urea nitrogen (BUN), N-acetylglucosamine (NAG), kidney injury molecule-1 (KIM-1) & urea while downregulating the concentrations of creatine clearance. Besides, the levels of B cell lymphoma-2 (Bcl-2) were reduced while the levels of cysteine-aspartic acid protease-9 (Caspase-9), Bcl-2-associated X protein (Bax) and cysteine-aspartic acid protease-3 (Caspase-3) were escalated after Cr intoxication. Renal tissues showed abnormal histology following the exposure to Cr. Nonetheless, ATN treatment effectively restored biochemical as well as histological impairments in renal tissues, thereby demonstrating the nephroprotective potential against Cr intoxication. CONCLUSION: ATN therapy showed significant renal protection via suppressing oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis and histological damages. These findings emphasize the important role of ATN in regulating renal health via modulating TLR4/MyD88, HMGB1/RAGE and NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：铬（Cr）是一种有毒重金属，据报道可诱发包括肾脏在内的多种器官损伤。阿斯廷（ATN）是一种多酚类黄酮化合物，显示出巨大的药理潜力。目的：本研究旨在评估ATN通过调节生化和组织学参数对Cr诱导的肾毒性潜在的缓解功效。方法：将三十二只雄性白化（Sprague Dawley）大鼠分为四组：第1组（对照组）、第2组（Cr 15 mg/kg）、第3组（Cr 15 mg/kg + ATN 10 mg/kg）和第4组（ATN 10 mg/kg）。通过qRT-PCR方案评估基因表达谱。其他生化参数水平通过标准ELISA方案及已报道的标准测定法进行评估。组织学检查按照组织病理学技术的基本原则进行。ATN的缓解作用进一步通过分子对接（MD）和分子动力学模拟（MDS）方法确认。结果：Cr中毒上调了高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）、核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）、环氧化酶-2（COX-2）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、髓样分化初级反应88（MYD88）、晚期糖基化终末产物受体（RAGE）、Toll样受体4（TLR4）和白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta）的基因表达。Cr中毒后，活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛水平升高，而谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）的活性以及谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量降低。此外，Cr暴露增加了胱抑素C、尿酸、中性粒细胞明胶酶相关脂质运载蛋白（NGAL）、肌酐、血尿素氮（BUN）、N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖（NAG）、肾损伤分子-1（KIM-1）和尿素的水平，同时下调了肌酐清除率。此外，Cr中毒后，B细胞淋巴瘤-2（Bcl-2）水平降低，而半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶-9（Caspase-9）、Bcl-2相关X蛋白（Bax）和半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶-3（Caspase-3）水平升高。Cr暴露后肾组织显示异常组织学。然而，ATN治疗有效恢复了肾组织中的生化和组织学损伤，从而显示出对Cr中毒的肾脏保护潜力。结论：ATN治疗通过抑制氧化应激、炎症、凋亡和组织学损伤，显示出显著的肾脏保护作用。这些发现强调了ATN通过调节TLR4/MyD88、HMGB1/RAGE和NF-kappaB信号通路在调节肾脏健康中的重要作用。
